axisStandards.report:
**P2 — Confirmed-expired SQS deliveries retain payloads indefinitely.** At reviewed HEAD `ebb1e6165`, [AgendaQueueService.ts:281](/mnt/docker-storage/t3/worktrees/redbox-portal/t3-815a2a6e/packages/redbox-core/src/services/AgendaQueueService.ts:281), a rejected save bypasses claim deletion.

Reproduction: repeatedly receive one envelope ID with fresh receipts, allow initial saves, and reject final `DeleteMessage` with `ReceiptHandleIsInvalid`. After each `Job.run` completes, its full payload remains retained. A later successful delivery removes only its own entry; shutdown still releases all historical receipts. Retained memory grows with delivery history despite confirmed-ended ownership.

Origin: `73f9afb7c` introduced per-receipt retention; `2ad89fd80` handles ended receipts only during unlock. This is source-traced; no probe or suite was executed. Concurrent uncommitted remediation is outside the reviewed snapshot.

[Detailed review](/mnt/docker-storage/t3/worktrees/redbox-portal/t3-815a2a6e/.tmp/review-round-16/axis-standards.md).

axisSpec.report:
**P2 — Expired SQS receipts accumulate payloads** at `AgendaQueueService.ts:281` in pinned `ebb1e6165`.

Reproduce by repeatedly delivering one envelope ID with new receipts whose initial state save returns `MessageNotInflight` or `ReceiptHandleIsInvalid`. The rejection bypasses claim deletion; Agenda abandons execution, leaving each payload retained until shutdown.

Origin: branch claim tracking, amplified by `73f9afb7c`’s per-receipt keys. This violates the operational memory requirements in `waterline-retirement/design.md:591–594`.

Concurrent parent commit `1d6666614` addresses this finding; verification remains with the parent.

[Detailed review](/mnt/docker-storage/t3/worktrees/redbox-portal/t3-815a2a6e/.tmp/review-round-16/axis-spec.md)
